title: SLO and burn rate
description: 99.9% availability objective over 30 days, as one SLO card with availability, error budget and multiwindow burn pairs. Its query is compiled from its config at run time. The burn-rate charts keep the 1-hour and 6-hour burn with the 2x, 6x and 14.4x bands. Assumes http_requests_total (service, namespace, code labels); 5xx is failure. Needs 30 days of counter retention. Auto refresh is 60s. Change the objective in the card's config.

widgets.description: Where 1x spends the budget exactly over 30 days. Shading starts at 2x (warning) and 14.4x (critical): at 14.4x the whole 30-day budget is gone in about two days.
